messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Re: Ruuning Jobs on cluster
parts:
It is possible that local mode runs quicker than distributed mode. I expect the
latter to outperform the former for larger data sets.

You could instrument your code and see where the cost is.

- monitor the (using top or ps) to see cpu/mem usage of the R processes
- you're not really reducing the size of the data - do you need a combiner? Does
it improve anything?
- see how long different parts take (in the reduce code)
- use counters to track how many times the reduce$reduce expression is being
called? How many elements is do.call("rbind",...) used on? rbind doesn't work
very well for a many data frames (that's where the combiner helps, reduces the
number of data frames going to reduce$reduce, but at the same time the size of
the data frames increase -oh well)

Regards

Saptarshi

the task after 10 minutes (600 sec) if it doesn't get the response and
by setting the parameter mapred.task.timeout=0 we can avoid killing
the tasks which are running for more than 10 min.
